sources.label: Official ARKET GB men's size guide (Tops: size conversion + body measurement, cm)

audit: Was 6 rows XS–XXL with one UK/EU size per letter (XS = UK 34 / EU 44), single values and US sizes. Official ARKET men's Tops chart: XS = EU 42 / UK 32R, then each letter spans two sizes (S = EU 44–46 / UK 34R–36R … XXL = EU 60–62 / UK 50R–52R), with cm ranges. M chest 98 → 96–100, waist 83 → 84–88; XS chest 88 → 84, waist 73 → 72. No US sizes on the official chart. ARKET's separate Shirts chart (collar sizes) is not used. Duplicate of arket-m2 (same brand and chart).
notes: H&M Group's elevated basics brand. Clean Scandinavian proportions — regular fit across most categories. Letter sizes span two EU/UK sizes (M = EU 48–50 / UK 38R–40R).
